sources.title: LLaDA-Image ships 6B open image model with full training recipe - AI Weekly
sources.snippet: A distilled variant, LLaDA-Image-Turbo, brings inference down to 2-4 sampling steps. The paper argues the base model "produces highly photorealistic images while accurately following fine-grained editing instructions," and the authors say they "release our model weights, training code, and detailed recipes" to support follow-on work.

sources.title: Training recipe | AI Research Papers
sources.snippet: A training recipeis a standardized set of hyperparameters, architectural configurations, and optimization procedures used to train a machine learning model to convergence. While the model architecture (like a Transformer) defines the "blueprint," the recipe provides the specific instructions for the training process.
